failure_case.summary: Fog + single runway + low fuel: zero legal candidates
failure_case.what_happened: The rule layer removed every slot. The system reported 'no safe plan, recommend diversion' and handed over to the human.
failure_case.why: With the rate halved, the earliest slot was 40 minutes out and fuel could not cover it.
failure_case.fix: Add diversion airports as candidates so the agents can negotiate a diversion instead of giving up.
